correctness.rationale: The inverse cyclic hat Gram matrix is explicitly derived by periodizing the exact tridiagonal Green sequence, absolute affine cell integrals yield F, kernel convexity identifies a maximizing knot, and sign inputs attain the norm. Infinite-line kernel L1 norm equals 2; a positive-measure opposite-sign overlap makes every finite cycle strict, and geometric tails prove convergence. Rational checks in 3<=n<=25 were run from the package program, with the infinite proof separate.
